title: Move a subtree and edit its child; a similar or identical subtree must not receive the edit
plan: #650 FX02; plan v3 §7.2 rows 'move a subtree and edit its child' (mandatory positive) and 'ambiguous correspondence'

provisional_text.note: a line merge sees the move as a deletion that overlaps the edited line; the mandatory positive is NOT met by the provisional profile

SILENT WRONG MERGE: with identical cards the line diff deletes the second card, so the edit applies cleanly to the card that stayed. Required: the edit follows the moved card, or a conflict. A composer on the text profile must not accept this candidate; only the complete-candidate behavior check catches it
